result.summary: Fixes out-of-bounds memory reads in UniValue's getJsonToken function by ensuring keyword checks and numeric prefix validations respect the token end pointer rather than assuming a null-terminated string. It also adapts the parse_univalue fuzz target and unit tests to exercise bounded string_view inputs.
result.problem: UniValue::read accepts a std::string_view that is not required to be null-terminated, but getJsonToken used strncmp and unchecked index lookups past the supplied end pointer, leading to potential out-of-bounds reads when processing bounded inputs.

result.card: This PR fixes two out-of-bounds memory read bugs in the vendored UniValue JSON parser when processing non-null-terminated string_view inputs, addressing issue #28260. The fix ensures that JSON keyword matching and numeric prefix validation respect the end boundary pointer. It also updates the parse_univalue fuzz target and unit tests to verify bounded string views without trailing null characters. Reviewers are supportive of the concept, with discussion focused on test fixture details, though the branch currently needs a rebase.
